name: Res_InstallFileServices
comment: Temp/Res.c: keeps a copy of the raw file services in g_ResFileServices and replaces svc->fopen..fprintf with the ResFile_* versions so every open goes through the LAB archive system

name: ResFile_Open
comment: Returns a 1-based handle into the 128-entry g_ResFileTable. Read-mode names without a path are looked up inside the open LAB archives first (entry = archive handle + offset + size); otherwise the underlying fopen is used.

name: ResFile_Read
proto: uint ResFile_Read(int fh, void * buf, uint n)
comment: Buffered (4 KB) read; archive-backed handles read through Lab_ReadRaw with the entry offset applied

name: ResFile_Seek
proto: int ResFile_Seek(int fh, int offset, int whence)

name: Lab_ReadRaw
proto: int Lab_ReadRaw(void * entry, void * buf, int offset, int n)
comment: Reads n bytes at offset inside an archive-backed file entry, clamped to the entry size

name: Lab_Close
comment: Closes an archive: unreferenced resources from it are freed, referenced ones get a private copy of their name and are detached

name: Lab_MoveToFront
comment: Makes the named archive the first one searched

name: Lab_FindFile
comment: Searches every open archive (or dev directory) for the file; fills a 0x210-byte entry {type, archiveFh, offset, size, inArchive, name}

name: Lab_Open
comment: Opens a .LAB archive, reads its directory with Lab_ReadDirectory

name: Lab_AllocRecord
comment: Takes a 0x120-byte archive record from g_pLabPool and links it at the head of g_pLabList

name: Lab_ReadDirectory
comment: Parses the LABN header (version, entry count, name table size) and the 16-byte entries into 0x1c-byte records {nameHash, name, ?, fourcc, a, b, 0}; names are hashed with Res_HashName

name: Lab_FindEntry
proto: int Lab_FindEntry(void * lab, int fourcc, char * lowerName, uint hash, void * outEntry)
comment: Hash + name match inside one archive; remembers the hit in the 16-slot recent-lookup ring

name: LabDir_Open
comment: Developer mode: a plain directory presented as an archive (12-byte entries {hash, name, 0})

name: LabDir_FindEntry
comment: Directory-backed archive lookup; fills the entry with the full path and the file size

name: Res_Load
comment: Loads (or finds) the resource and returns its data pointer; the record is moved to the front of the LRU list

name: Res_SetLocked
comment: Locks (flag 8) a resource against Res_FreeUnreferenced; returns the previous unlocked state

name: Res_FreeUnreferenced
comment: Walks the LRU list from the oldest end freeing unreferenced, unlocked resources until bytesWanted is reached; calls the yield hook every 5 items

name: Res_WriteReport
comment: Dumps 'Resource %12s size %7ld REFERENCED' lines for every loaded resource

name: ResType_Find
comment: Finds the handler record {next, ?, fourcc, handlerFn} registered for a resource type

name: Res_FindByName
comment: Hashes the name and scans the resource list for a record of the same type and hash (skipping records with flag 2)

name: Res_LoadInternal
proto: void * Res_LoadInternal(int type, char * name, int * status)
comment: Asks the type handler to load {op=1, name, type}; on status 1 finds the new record and asks the handler for its size {op=3}

name: Res_CreateRecord
proto: void * Res_CreateRecord(int type, char * name, void * data)
comment: Allocates a 0x2c-byte record {next, prev, name, hash, type, data, handle, flags, lab, refs, size} from g_pResPool; the name is shared with the LAB directory when the recent-lookup ring knows it

name: Res_CallUnload
comment: Invalidates all ResRefs of the record and sends {op=2, name, type, data} to the type handler

name: ResType_DefaultHandler
comment: Handler for plain file resources: op 1 opens the file and reads it into a handle allocation (hAlloc/hLock), op 2 frees it

name: Res_MoveToFront
comment: LRU touch: moves the record to the head of the resource list

name: Res_HashName
comment: Rotate-left/xor hash over the lower-cased name (seeded with the length); also writes the lower-cased name to outLower

name: ResRef_Add
proto: void ResRef_Add(void * ref, void * data, char * file, int line)
comment: Registers a 0x34-byte reference {valid, data, tag[0x20], line, prev, next} on the resource so it cannot be freed

name: Res_FirstOfType
proto: void Res_FirstOfType(void ** iter, void ** data, int type)

name: Res_NextOfType
proto: void Res_NextOfType(void ** iter, void ** data, int type)

comment: Service table pointer used by Temp/Res.c

name: Engine_PlayMovie
proto: int Engine_PlayMovie(char * name, int fullscreen, int a, int b, int c)
comment: sputmain.cpp: starts a movie on the back buffer (or the primary surface when fullscreen) and sets g_nGameMode to 3

name: Engine_SaveGame
comment: Writes grim.sav (or the requested name): 250x188 thumbnail, costumes, each registered module's save hook, game mode, Lua state

name: Engine_RestoreGame
comment: Reads a save in the same order Engine_SaveGame wrote it, then runs patch05.bin

name: SaveGame_LoadThumbnail
comment: Returns a 250x188 16-bit bitmap read from the head of a save file

name: SaveFile_Read
proto: int SaveFile_Read(void * f, void * buf, int n)

name: SaveFile_Write
proto: int SaveFile_Write(void * f, void * buf, int n)

name: Polyglot_Load
comment: Engine/polyglot.c: loads the language table (grim.tab). An 'RCNE' header means the body is XORed with 0xDD. Lines are split on CR, cut at the TAB between id and text, and sorted for binary search.
Whole decoded language table text
Number of id/text lines in the language table
Sorted array of language table lines
